basalt_elastic_analogue.role: coherent rock domains / basal rock analogue
assumptions: E40GPa nu.30 rho2900 from crust column Table1, not a tested local core
shared basalt analogue for all three bodies, not a claim that every Earth/Moon site is basaltic
no joints, crushing or tensile failure; bonded continuum boundaries
clast/lens distribution and rock depth are explicit scenario assumptions
basalt_elastic_analogue.name: basalt_elastic_analogue

earth_sand_dr30_dp_reference.role: dry granular ground: constant elastic stiffness, frictional perfect plasticity
assumptions: Dr30 official suggested skeleton; not site calibration
grain density2650 assumed, dry bulk2650/(1+0.85)
G/K at80kPa scaled to101kPa by sqrt(101/80)
no pore-pressure DOF; numerical_c300Pa is not MC cohesion
Explicit simpler DP alternative to PDMY02: constant reference E/G/K, no pressure-dependent elastic modulus, no contraction/dilation cyclic law
triaxial compression matching; not fitting actual sand experiments; reference modulus sensitivity required
earth_sand_dr30_dp_reference.name: earth_sand_dr30_dp_reference

earth_sand_dr50_dp_reference.role: dry granular ground: constant elastic stiffness, frictional perfect plasticity
assumptions: grain density2650kg/m3 assumed, e.70 gives dry bulk1558.82kg/m3
constitutive skeleton suggested sand parameters; not a site or dry-soil experimental calibration
G/K scaled80to101kPa with exponent.5 to resolve source reference-pressure ambiguity
no groundwater/pore-pressure DOF; numerical_c300Pa NOT physical cohesion
Explicit simpler DP alternative to PDMY02: constant reference E/G/K, no pressure-dependent elastic modulus, no contraction/dilation cyclic law
triaxial compression matching; not fitting actual sand experiments; reference modulus sensitivity required
earth_sand_dr50_dp_reference.name: earth_sand_dr50_dp_reference
